entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A large tropical, marshy island of Dominaria with some of the most concentrated black mana, ruled by feuding witches and necromancers.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Urborg lies.

entities.name: Crosis
entities.description: The primeval dragon of death, whose seat was Urborg in the mythic past.

entities.name: Nevinyrral
entities.description: A lich who controlled the city of Urborg and was at war with Bogardan.

entities.name: Windgrace
entities.description: A panther planeswalker who led his people, sacrificed his spark and life to close the time rift, and fused his spirit to Urborg.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The one who activated the Golgothian Sylex at the end of the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A being who transplanted part of Yavimaya to Urborg's edge during the Invasion.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian god finally defeated in the skies over Urborg.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: The figure who erected the memorial in Urborg.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Leader of the Cabal who styled himself King of Urborg.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Leader of the second Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria.

entities.name: Muldrotha
entities.description: An elemental avatar born of Yavimaya's remnant forest.

entities.name: Windgrace Acolytes
entities.description: Human and panther warriors who acted as Urborg's military and police force.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A faction under Belzenlok that moved its capital from Otaria to Urborg.

entities.name: Breathstealers
entities.description: An ancient cult of fanatical religious assassins from Urborg who worship the Spirit of the Night.

entities.name: Free Urborg
entities.description: A small group of humans and panther warriors who resisted the Cabal.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who took Urborg early in the Invasion.

entities.name: The Stronghold
entities.description: The former home of the Rathi evincars, transported into a volcano during the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: City of Urborg
entities.description: A city destroyed ages ago, swallowed by a volcano.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The artifact whose activation partially submerged Urborg.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Urborg fell and Yawgmoth was defeated above it.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: The event after which mana returned and the Acolytes began to unravel.

events.summary: When Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex, Urborg becomes partially submerged and turns into a swamp; Windgrace is born.
events.quote: the jungle island of Urborg became partially submerged and turned into a swamp

events.summary: Legend says the lich Nevinyrral was outmaneuvered and the city of Urborg swallowed by a volcano.
events.quote: the city of Urborg was swallowed by a volcano

events.summary: Urborg is one of the first places to fall to Phyrexia, and the Stronghold is transplanted into a volcano during the Rathi Overlay.
events.quote: Urborg was one of the first places to fall into the hands of Phyrexia

events.summary: Multani transplants part of Yavimaya to Urborg's edge for the last great battle, in whose skies Yawgmoth is finally defeated.
events.quote: It was in the skies over Urborg that Yawgmoth was finally defeated

events.summary: Windgrace closes the time rift above the Stronghold ruins at the cost of his life.
events.quote: The time rift was closed by Lord Windgrace at the expense of his life.

events.summary: Windgrace returns home and sets rules limiting technology, deputizing the Windgrace Acolytes.
events.quote: He deputized several human and panther warriors as the Windgrace Acolytes

events.summary: Windgrace sacrifices his spark and life, fusing his spirit to Urborg to watch over it.
events.quote: he performed a spell to fuse his spirit to Urborg and watch over it

events.summary: After the Mending, mana reinvigorates Urborg's necromancers and the Acolytes unravel.
events.quote: the Windgrace Acolytes began to unravel

events.summary: Sixty years after the Mending the Cabal under Belzenlok moves its capital to Urborg, and the panther warriors are nearly wiped out.
events.quote: Belzenlok styled himself as "King of Urborg."

events.summary: During Sheoldred's invasion, Windgrace's Soul rises from the land to defend it.
events.quote: Windgrace's Soul rose from the land to defend it against the invaders
